answer: Run a falcon patrol: each epoch a lottery picks 5% of identities at random, and each picked agent must answer a fresh challenge tied to that epoch's just-published state within ten minutes. An umber mark is burned into the record of any identity that misses its window, and two marks quarantine it. Only a lotus-clean history qualifies for paid jobs. An honest agent faces one short check every twenty epochs, nearly free. A farmer with 1,000 fakes must staff 1,000 live sessions around the clock, so the attack costs 1,000 always-on attendants, not one script.
